author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
3D model of my high school fly over, burnt 1 week worth of my Opus 5.5 tokens to build it from reference Youtube drone footage.

It is close enough, but still not very accurate, I have spent some time yelling at the AI to make it do a better job. It has reach diminish of return of my human attention. It is the best I can get with this generation of LLM with minimal effort. I will try again when Opus 6 comes out.

https://lnkd.in/gbz8am22
